steps.title: Open the Chrome Web Store listing
steps.body: Use Chrome or another Chromium browser (Edge, Brave, Arc) — Firefox and Safari can't install it.
steps.verifierLabel: The Dripwriter Origin store page is open

steps.title: Add it to your browser
steps.body: Click “Add to Chrome”, then confirm with “Add extension” in the small dialog.
steps.verifierLabel: The button changes to “Remove from Chrome”

point.descriptor: the Add to Chrome button on the store page

steps.title: Pin it to the toolbar
steps.body: Click the puzzle-piece icon by the address bar, then the pin next to Dripwriter Origin.
steps.verifierLabel: The Dripwriter icon sits in your toolbar

steps.title: Open a Google Doc
steps.body: Any document works — a blank one is fine.
steps.verifierLabel: A document is open in Google Docs

steps.title: Try it in the document
steps.body: Click the Dripwriter icon and paste some text — it types it into the Doc at a human pace.
steps.verifierLabel: Pasted text is being typed into your document
